new_categories.label: protective_coating_barrier_readiness
new_categories.memory: Cargo-hold protective coating/corrosion-barrier readiness is a service-state distinct from the underlying structural boundary condition.

new_categories.label: coating_coverage_scope_confidence
new_categories.memory: Protective-barrier confidence can be bounded to a hold, zone or surface scope without retaining exact coating layout, layer system or coverage area.

new_categories.label: non_numeric_coating_condition_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-numeric coating-condition confidence state can be represented without retaining film thickness, breakdown percentage, corrosion values or defect dimensions.

new_categories.label: substrate_interface_confidence
new_categories.memory: Confidence in the coating-to-substrate protective interface is distinct from both coating appearance and structural substrate condition, without retaining adhesion values or preparation details.

new_categories.label: protective_continuity_confidence
new_categories.memory: Protective continuity across a bounded surface can degrade separately from local visible condition without retaining actual repair maps or defect geometry.

new_categories.label: inspection_verification_confidence
new_categories.memory: Inspection/verification confidence is distinct from physical coating condition and can degrade without retaining inspection methods, readings or acceptance criteria.

new_categories.label: independent_check_confidence
new_categories.memory: Independent cross-check confidence can be represented separately from shipboard self-assessment and from coating or substrate physical state.

new_categories.label: maintenance_need_confidence
new_categories.memory: A non-procedural confidence state that protective maintenance is needed can be represented without specifying preparation, product, application or repair actions.

new_categories.label: hold_availability_not_coating_state_equivalence
new_categories.memory: Hold availability or structural-maintenance restriction is a downstream outcome and is not equivalent to coating/barrier physical or verification state.

new_categories.label: coating_barrier_degradation_lifecycle
new_categories.memory: Protective coating/barrier service can move through available, degraded, restricted, under-inspection, under-restoration and restored states with separate timestamps.

new_categories.label: scoped_restriction_and_isolation
new_categories.memory: Restriction/isolation can attach separately to a surface scope, protective continuity, substrate-interface confidence, inspection confidence or restoration-verification state.

new_categories.label: downstream_effect_not_root_cause_proof
new_categories.memory: Inspection concern, structural-maintenance restriction, hold unavailability, repair/rework or schedule effects do not prove a coating-system, substrate-interface or scope root cause.

new_categories.label: multi_timestamp_coating_restoration
new_categories.memory: Protective-barrier correction, substrate review, inspection, independent verification, restriction release and hold return-to-service can occur at different times.

useful_refinements.label: structural_boundary_vs_protective_barrier
useful_refinements.memory: P113 underlying structural-boundary condition does not duplicate the coating/corrosion barrier applied to that boundary.

useful_refinements.label: cleanliness_surface_readiness_vs_coating_condition
useful_refinements.memory: P109 cleanliness, residue and dryness/surface readiness do not establish protective-coating continuity or coating-to-substrate confidence.

useful_refinements.label: maintenance_need_vs_repair_procedure
useful_refinements.memory: A bounded protective-maintenance need state is distinct from any coating application, repair or surface-preparation procedure, which remains deferred.

useful_refinements.label: generic_equipment_lifecycle_vs_delivered_protective_barrier
useful_refinements.memory: P067 generic lifecycle/support semantics do not establish delivered protective-coating/corrosion-barrier condition assurance.

duplicates.label: generic_condition_interface_verification_pattern
duplicates.memory: Generic physical-condition, interface confidence and verification mechanics repeat prior service-state families.

duplicates.label: generic_scoped_restriction_downstream_restoration
duplicates.memory: Generic scope localization, downstream-effect separation and multi-stage verified restoration are already campaign-wide.

reviewed_no_specific_memory: exact coating products, layer systems, surface-preparation grades, colors, current configuration or coverage maps
exact dry-film thickness, coating breakdown area, corrosion values, adhesion values, defect dimensions, inspection readings or acceptance limits
exact coating preparation, application, repair, curing, testing, isolation, ventilation, entry or return-to-service procedures
named coating makers, inspectors, contractors, ports, yards, incidents, deficiency findings or current-readiness facts
negative_space: exact coating products, systems, layers, surface preparation, thickness, breakdown area, corrosion values, adhesion or defect dimensions and current configuration
exact inspection methods, readings, acceptance criteria, coating specifications and rule thresholds
exact preparation, application, repair, curing, testing, isolation, ventilation, entry, emergency or return-to-service procedures
named coating makers, inspectors, contractors, ports, yards, incidents, findings, current readiness and private/regional/non-English lineages
stop_reason: The bounded protective-coating/barrier questions are answered; further recall trends toward exact coating systems, thickness/breakdown/corrosion values, inspection criteria, application/repair procedures, providers or incidents that are deferred to Evidence.
epistemic_boundary: Memory-only defensive dry-cargo hold protective-coating/corrosion-barrier condition orientation and source-discovery output; not coating selection, surface preparation, application, repair or inspection guidance and not proof of any exact product, thickness, defect, acceptance criterion, procedure, provider, incident or current-readiness fact.
